items.item_text: Bachelor's degree in related area and/or equivalent experience/training.
4 - 7 years of related experience.
Previous supervisory/managerial experience.
Supervises the work of a department or section with responsibility for quality and quantity of work. (20% time)
Reviews processes and approves transactions. (15% time)
Ensures accuracy and controls of payroll data, reporting, and reconciliations. (15% time)
Participates in the selection, development and evaluation of staff to ensure the efficient operation of the function. (10% time)
Recommends personnel-related actions. (5% time)
Follows and interprets policies and procedures for payroll process and timekeeping. (5% time)
Ensures the generation of payroll, including labor distribution records, vacation and sick leave accrual, overtime and withholding status, benefits and miscellaneous deductions. (5% time)
Meets all government reporting requirements for payroll taxes, withholding and employer contributions. (5% time)
Researches and resolves unique and complex issues and discrepancies. (5% time)
Serves as front-line mediator for staff issues. (5% time)

Communication and Team Collaboration: Acting as a liaison and effectively communicating with staff, SSC Partners, ASSET Leadership, and external peers (i.e. other SSC peers). Works with assigned staff to develop and promote organizational objectives. Establishing brief daily huddles or virtual check-ins to discuss priorities, roadblocks. Celebrate small wins, ensuring everyone understands why behind their tasks. Meeting with SSC Partners on an as needed basis ensure consistency and continuity of information as well as focusing on and address any pain points or anticipated issues that may arise or address those that have presented themselves and address them as a priority item. Conduct monthly SSC Partner meetings to provide operational updates, discuss ongoing issues and provide hands-on training. (5% time)

Working Supervisor Role: Spends significant time performing unit tasks alongside staff, especially in high-volume roles. Will continue to monitor current assigned ORGs as well as serve as secondary point of contact for escalation requests. Additionally, the supervisor will serve as back up when manager is out of the office. (5% time)
Read/Comprehend: Frequently
Write: Frequently
Perform Calculations: Constantly
Communicate Orally: Frequently
Reason & Analyze: Constantly
Sit: Constantly
Stand: Occasionally
Walk: Occasionally
Strong working knowledge of payroll function.
Knowledge of bargaining unit agreements.
Effective verbal and written communication skills.
Proficiency in payroll systems, general office software applications, and payroll reporting software.
Supervisory skills and experience, and service orientation.
Working knowledge of UC or UCR policies, procedures and systems
Working knowledge of UCPath or PeopleSoft.
